brief:
Eye on Palestine reported that a pro-occupation supporter posted a video showing himself removing a sticker bearing the Palestinian flag from a pole. The activist presented the action as a significant accomplishment, framing the sticker removal as a noteworthy achievement in the footage he shared online.

The post characterizes the gesture as hollow and performative, suggesting the activist was attempting to manufacture a display of heroism around an inconsequential act. Critics view such stunts as efforts to claim symbolic victories in broader political disputes.
dek: In a pathetic attempt to manufacture a fake heroic “achievement,” a pro-occupation supporter appears in a video removing a sticker bearing the Palestinian flag from a pole, boasting about this hollow act as if he had decided a historic battle! Empty,…
title: Activist removes Palestinian flag sticker in video, claims victory
